introduction: North Dakota TANF supports qualifying families with dependent children. The Self-Service Portal and paper application routes begin the state’s eligibility review.
description: North Dakota TANF supports qualifying families with dependent children. The Self-Service Portal and paper application routes begin the state’s eligibility review.

sections.who: The state considers income, resources, children’s ages, caregiver relationships and deprivation conditions. Some pregnancy situations may qualify.
sections.get: Approved cash is delivered through an Electronic Payment Card. Eligible participants may also receive employment-related help through JOBS.
sections.docs:
• Identity, residence and children’s ages.
  • Caregiver relationship records.
  • Current and previous-month income, requested assets and allowable expenses.
sections.apply:
1. Apply for TANF

    Use the state application options or request a mailed form.

  2. Complete the case review

    Respond to the eligibility worker’s requests and explain caregiving, school and employment circumstances.

  3. Discuss participation

    Ask about any JOBS or child-support cooperation requirement and how to report a barrier or safety concern.
sections.after: Review the cash decision and participation plan separately. Keep records of required activities and report changes as instructed.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TANF categories, documents and application. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is the cash card the SNAP food card?
The state identifies TANF delivery through an Electronic Payment Card.
The state includes a school and expected-graduation condition for certain children approaching age 19.
Where can I ask about missing records?
The Customer Support Center lists 866-614-6005 and applyforhelp@nd.gov.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
